symptom: The world WebSocket sent one snapshot and then nothing. wrangler tail showed one alarm (wall 1285 ms, cpu 505 ms) and then a canceled alarm. setAlarm was the last statement of alarm(), so a throw, cancel, or overrun ended the loop.
root_causes_seen_in_tail: Dynamic worker concurrency limit exceeded: each request may have up to 10 concurrent dynamic worker invocations. All creatures were stepped with one Promise.all.
Some creature steps ran longer than the tick.

fix.alarm_first: src/worker/world.ts alarm() calls setAlarm before tick() and catches tick errors
fix.bounded_work: src/worker/tick.ts: at most 16 creatures per tick (round-robin cursor), 8 concurrent steps, 600 ms per step via withTimeout, 50 ms CPU limit per Dynamic Worker
fix.isolation: runSteps logs and penalizes a failing or slow creature and continues
fix.rearm_on_connect: World.fetch calls ensureAlarm before anything else; nextAlarmAt re-arms a stale or far-future alarm

proof.tool: headless Chrome via puppeteer-core, CDP Network.webSocketFrameReceived
proof.gate: snapshot_frames >= 15 and positions change between frames: passed
